messages:
ajay: Heads up — we're designing a tiny keystore proxy to centralize KMS calls for envelope workflows. quick questions: authz model (who can sign/unwrap), sampling for audit logs, and how aggressive we can cache DEKs without breaking rotation. any strong opinions?
marco: can we get the use-cases first? is this for hosted customers only or also private deployments?
ajay: both. we want the same API surface for hosted and private but with different backends (AWS/GCP/Azure). hosted will use a managed proxy; private can run the proxy in-customer VPC.
linda: main safety rails: 1) KEK ops (wrap/unwrap) should be RBAC-gated and logged at high fidelity 2) DEKs can be cached per-machine but TTL needs to align with rotation windows 3) short grace period after rotate for replay protection
security-bot: @ajay suggested baseline: wrap/unwrap calls require role: kms-operator; key policy binds to service principal. audit log sampling 100% for wrap, 10% for unwrap (to reduce noise) — flagging for review.
ajay: thinking: keep unwrap sampling high too? unwrap is high-volume and logs are huge. we need meaningful sampling so we can detect misuse but not drown S3/Logstore. suggestions?
marco: compromise: 100% for unwraps that result in new DEK generation or when key metadata flags 'high-risk', else 1-5% for routine unwraps. add a burst buffer to capture first N unwraps per principal per minute.
linda: agree. also emit a lightweight metric on unwrap-rate-per-principal and alert on spikes >3x baseline. forensics can trigger a full log pull.
sre-oncall: what's the plan for rate-limits? KMS vendors throttle; our proxy should do smoothing/backoff. propose token-bucket per-customer + global pool fallback.
ajay: example config i'm prototyping: 
```
proxy.kms_cache.dek_ttl_seconds = 600   # 10m default
proxy.kms_cache.max_entries = 100000
proxy.kms_unwrap_sampling.default = 0.02
proxy.kms_unwrap_sampling.high_risk = 1.0
proxy.kms_rate_limit.per_customer_qps = 50
proxy.kms_rate_limit.global_burst = 200
```
marco: looks fine. DEK TTL depends on request patterns. for low-latency chat endpoints, 10m is ok; for batch embedding jobs maybe longer. allow per-route overrides.
linda: rotation: plan KEK rotate at monthly cadence, but support emergency rotate. DEKs should be rewrapped lazily: keep DEKs until next rotate window then rewrap on first use. but we need a max-staleness cutoff (e.g., 7 days) to force rewrap.
legal-ops: please ensure audit retention meets SOC requirements (7 years for certain ops). sampling should never drop critical ops for regulated customers.
ajay: noted. we will add per-customer audit policies that can override sampling to 100% when needed.
devex: what about RBAC surface? simple roles: kms-operator (wrap/unwrap), kms-reader (metadata), kms-audit (view logs). admin can assign. use groups from org SSO + SCIM syncing.
linda: also add delegated keys: a proxy can act on behalf with short-lived delegated tokens (STS) audited as proxy actions. that limits long-lived credentials.
marco: incident flow: if a KEK is suspected compromised — 1) rotate KEK immediately 2) mark affected DEKs as 'requires-rewrap' 3) throttle unwraps for affected customers, 4) snapshot logs and escalate to legal + secops. is that workable?
sre-oncall: add an automated mitigation: proxy flips to 'wrap-only' mode for the rotated KEK to stop new unwraps until rewrap completes. reduces blast radius.
ajay: good. what about KMS call frequency during a mass rotate? we could overwhelm KMS. ideas?
linda: coordinate rewrap background jobs with rate-limiter + jitter + exponential backoff. and prioritize rewraps by customer risk/tier.
marco: add a migration plan: phased rewrap with per-customer concurrency cap. run a 'dry-run' to estimate calls: sample N DEKs and measure unwrap+rewrap latency.
natalie: (legal-ops) confirm: maintain mapping of DEK->KEK version and time of last unwrap for auditability.
security-bot: checklist to implement: [x] per-principal rate-limits [x] per-customer audit overrides [x] sampling config flags [ ] enforcement of wrap-only on rotate [ ] rewrap backlog manager
ajay: i'll file a design doc and attach a prototype proxy. thanks for the quick takes — i'll post follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
marco: please include a small simulator for KMS QPS so we can tune defaults before rollout.
linda: one more: add a 'revoke' flag that makes the proxy reject cached DEKs immediately when compliance requests revocation. that should also kick rewraps.
ajay: noted, will add revoke endpoint. thanks everyone.
